entry.name: Gap
entry.label: Gap in pixels between snapped windows (no gap at work-area edges)

entry.name: QuickTileGaps
entry.label: Apply the gap to windows snapped to halves and quarters

entry.name: FillOtherHalf
entry.label: After snapping a window, offer other windows for the empty half (or the empty zones of a layout chosen in the flyout)

entry.name: PairWindows
entry.label: Windows snapped together form a group: they minimize, restore and come to the front together

entry.name: LegacyWidthCycle
entry.label: Cycle widths with Left and Right instead of directional snapping
